Audio in from an external source.

The actual source of the audio must be set on each processing block using UGen::setInput() or UGen::setInputs(). The host IO objects (e.g., JuceHostIO handle this on your behalf by having an internal AudioIn UGen)

See also:
JuceHostIO, UGen::setInput(), UGen::setInputs()
